x: Those of you who have not yet paid your subscriptions might be interested to know that one of the first subs. to be received was from 78 years old G.TYRER, who said in his accompanying letter,"...so when you no longer continue to get my sub. you will know I have buzzed off"!!
We also have to announce the death of another old stalwart, George Tyrer, known to several generations of members as the man who made a point of turning out in the September road-run every year.
Lew Causer then celebrating his 20th season at cross country was leader and coach of the novice pack and a fine coach he was,ably assisted at times by George Tyrer.
